oracle_method: CSV/TXT stdlib csv and datetime; PDF glyphs and explicit grid coordinates with pdfminer, no agrobr imports or production table extractor.
limits: Captured on 2026-09-18; the publication identifies update 2026-09-04 and periodic edition 2026-04-06. CSV/TXT/PDF hashes equal the older preserved capture; no new edition is claimed.
CSV/TXT/PDF are renderings of the same publication, not independent sources for N3.
PDF oracles use independent glyph/grid reading, but pdfminer is also an underlying dependency of production pdfplumber; extraction-engine independence is not claimed.
Two wrapped establishment names differ between PDF and CSV; each format has its own exact oracle, with no cross-format repair.
Capture uses the real client; the HTTP matcher verifies URLs/methods and consumption, not global request order. The independent portal inventory checks all link decisions.
No cache and no historical edition selector. Current acquisition instants in HTTP replay are replay instants; original capture times remain in receipts.

Derived text fields collapse whitespace as declared in column_decisions; six captured CSV establishment cells are affected. data_inclusao_texto stays literal: ten PDF inclusion cells retain line breaks, in addition to the two establishment differences.

csv_whitespace_normalization.rule: Internal whitespace collapsed as in production compact(); source bodies remain byte-for-byte unchanged

masking.regra: decisão do mantenedor (25/09/2026): cópia mascarada. CPF de pessoa física trocado por CPF sintético com DV válido da série fixa 000.000.NNN-DV, na ordem da primeira aparição; nome da pessoa física trocado por 'PESSOA NNN', também onde aparece dentro de Estabelecimento; CPF dentro da razão social de pessoa jurídica trocado pelo CPF sintético, com o resto do nome como publicado; CNPJ e demais dados de pessoa jurídica como publicados. Mesmo layout: no TXT, a largura de cada campo; no PDF, os mesmos glifos (ToUnicode), posições e quebras de linha. Originais fora do repositório, com SHA-256,
